Here rival 724 (3,1) holds a full-strength Shield burst (token slot 632 (12,4), +136=2000); a deflection debits 60000>>2=15000 onto 724.+140 leaving 1603, so retail reads 1603 < 2000 -> REFUSE -> +48=1; -- -> 0. A CLASS-12 TOKEN'S CASTER IS THE TOKEN'S OWN +42, NOT THE WIZARD REGISTER THAT NAMES IT. That ONE extra new_event shifted every later LIFO pop by one, which is the entire slot 741 / slot 995 row set -- the mana delta 188,830 vs 175,830 is a CONSEQUENCE, not a cause. ⭐ THE BRIEF'S 'retail seizes LIVE records' PREMISE IS REFUTED: NewEvent_372C0 (file 0x4FAB8) has exactly two arms -- free-stack pop (index +40, cells +593) then recycle victim (index +4593, cells +4597) -- and NULL; retail's free stack at t=20528 is t=20527's minus exactly its top element (344), so 741/651/995 were freed by their own dying occupants inside the tick and re-popped LIFO. LABEL_12 is the loop's CONTINUE, past ALL THREE registration writes - `+16 |= 1` (:19428), `+42 = the wizard's slot` (:19429) and `+532[v6] = the pool slot` (:19430) - so with 24/24 seats taken the newborn is born ORPHANED: flags 4, +42 = 0, in nobody's book. It is then never polled (+70 = 3*spell is the spell's own manifest dispatch row in str_2563D8 :4957-5028, never sub_56250/sub_56260 -> sub_55A40) and never freed (actLife 0): over the take's remaining 40,240 ticks only its +20 list link and its +63 clock ever change, and retail declines all 9,942 of its due already-known polls. THE OWNED-TOKEN REGISTER IS A RAW SLOT INDEX AND RETAIL NEVER CHECKS WHAT LIVES THERE. sub_14E60 (VA 0x14E60 = CARPET.EXE file 0x2D658) resolves a wizard's owned-token register wizext+676+2*spell as a SIGNED index -- VERIFIED in the shipped bytes: `0f bf 94 42 a4 02 00 00` movswl 0x2a4(edx,eax,2),edx, then lea/add/lea/add/lea building 164*idx (the entity stride), add the pool base, and `39 d0` cmp / `76` jbe against that base. That bounds check is the ONLY guard: no class, no flags, no liveness. Its caller sub_14120 (file 0x2C971) then runs `66 83 78 30 00` cmpw $0,0x30(eax) / `0f 85` jne -- the +48 word of WHATEVER RECORD NOW OCCUPIES THE SLOT. The port homes retail's +48 in Ent::f26 only while the record is a live class-12 manifestation; on any other class f26 is retail's +26, a different word entirely. WITNESS mc1l49 t=26530: wizard 1's owned[16] = 26, and slot 26 has been recycled into a (9,16) bolt whose +26 = 16 and whose +48 = 0. Retail passes the gate and promotes the rival RaidCastle -> Upgrade (brain 7 -> 1, +146 933 -> 619, +148 1084 -> 980); the port read 16, refused, and stayed on the raid -- the sole pair row was `slot 594 chase: retail 619 port 933`. This EXTENDS MGC_NO_MC1_FREED_TOKEN_BURST (which already covers a FREED slot, class64 == 0) to the slot RE-TAKEN by a live record of another class, where that import seat cannot fire without clobbering the new record's own +26. The class64 == 0 arm is load-bearing and measured: without it mc1l49 loses this head but grows a new one at t=35374. New lane Ent::raw48 is hash-silent by construction (empty Hash impl, like Lease2e) and off the snapshot wire, so goldens and SNAPSHOT_VERSION do not move. mc1l49 15 seg/14 devs -> 14/13 alone (12/11 with the wave's D5); the 6,002 and 5,531 tick segments merge into one 11,533-tick bit-exact run. Corpus 17 identical / 1 improved / 0 regressed. Kill switch MGC_NO_MC1_TOKEN_RAW48. Wave 121 dig D2.

THE ERUPTION DRIVER RE-READS +26 FROM MEMORY, AND THE START BLOCK'S REGISTER KICK CAN LAND ON ITS OWN SLOT. sub_25EC0 re-reads +26 at all three points after the eruption-start block: :28803 (v13 = *(a1+26); CARPET.EXE 0x3E88A `66 8b 7b 1a` = `mov 0x1a(%ebx),%di`, then 0x3E891 `test %di,%di` / 0x3E894 `75 77 jne 0x3E90D` - the blast is SKIPPED straight to the death check), :28825 (0x3E90D `66 83 7b 1a 7f` = `cmpw $0x7f,0x1a(%ebx)`) and :28831 (0x3E928 `66 ff 43 1a` = `incw 0x1a(%ebx)`, an in-memory ++). It matters because the start block's kick *(prev+26)=250 (0x3E7B6 `66 c7 42 1a fa 00`) is a BLIND write guarded ONLY by slot != 0 (0x3E7B4 `76 06`), so when the stale global `erupting` register names the very pool slot just recycled into THIS driver, retail SELF-KICKS its own +26 to 250 - and then mints NO eruption-start blast (250 != 0), reap-flags itself on its first tick (250 >= 127), clears the register it set two instructions earlier, and ends recording +26 = 251. WITNESS t=29061: erupting=968 with slot 968 a long-stale reap-flagged (10,6) (act_life -2); the pool recycles 968 into the new (10,18) driver and retail records f26 0 -> 251, flags 132100 -> 1024, f30 0 -> 1280, popping ONE slot all tick (free stack 262 -> 261, next-pop 168 -> 169) for a (10,13) at 168. The port cached c at entry, minted a spurious (9,0) blast at 168 (sclass/smodel 255 is new_event's default +66=+67=0xFF, :43879 - a fresh blast fireball, NOT a record missing its source) and pushed retail's (10,13) to 169; because the blast consumes a free-stack slot the defect surfaces as an ENTITY-SET divergence. The register-block gate (:28778 / 0x3E779) is deliberately left on the entry value - retail re-reads there too, but only the pure ground query sub_11F50 runs between, so the two are provably identical. mc1l49 pair 29061->29062 becomes bit-exact. Switch MGC_NO_MC1_ERUPTION_COUNTER_REREAD=1. Round 120 dig W120-4.

Retail's human wizard IS an ordinary pool class-3 record (mc1l49 slot 569), so his candidacy for a projectile's acquire is decided by the SAME tick-top roster sweep as every rival carpet: sub_41780_41AC0's case-3 arm (:52253-62) links a record onto bucket[0] (var_u32_36462[0]) only when `actLife >= 0 && (+16 & 0x10) == 0` -- VERIFIED in the shipped bytes at CARPET.EXE 0x5A151 `83 78 0c 00` cmpl $0,0xc(eax) / `7c 24` jl / `f6 40 10 10` testb $0x10,0x10(eax) / `75 1e` jne, then `89 83 6e 8e 00 00` writes the head at +0x8e6e (= 36462). And sub_54520's case-0/3/4 arm walks THAT VERY HEAD (CARPET.EXE 0x6CEB9 `8b 9b 6e 8e 00 00` mov 0x8e6e(ebx),ebx). The port's Gen::aim_assist_mc1_cone2 injected the out-of-pool human as a Scan-A candidate with NO liveness test at all, so once the human fell (mc1l49 t=34530, actLife -970) every fireball cast afterwards locked his CORPSE and bent 23-34 units of yaw off the muzzle bearing for the rest of its flight. Our human is out of pool, so his seat rides the TICK-TOP latch ctx.pdead_top, never the live pdead -- exactly as Gen::nearest_wizard_target (mobs.rs:1176) and Gen::first_wizard_with_mana (mobs.rs:2084) already do for the same list; the acquire was the one call path that did not. WITNESS pair 34531->34532: slot 981 chase retail 0 port 569, heading 260/283, target_yaw 260/283; slot 90 heading 260/283, pitch 1954/1958. THE DIG ABORT IS THE CELL'S RETURN, NOT THE `protect` FLAG. `sub_40D30_41070` (:51711-16, CARPET.EXE 0x595a9 `test al,al / je <next cell>`) walks the ring template and returns 1 on ANY nonzero cell result; the `a5` argument it was handed is only FORWARDED, never tested there. The port ANDed the abort with `protect`, so the latch was unreachable for the two non-protect diggers (`Gen::tick_hill` = `sub_25470` byte70 9, `Gen::tick_ridge_head`), and `dig_cell`'s own doc comment inherited the false claim that the latch is 'dead in practice'. THE DIG CENTRE AND THE RING DELTAS ARE SIGNED. `sub_40D30_41070` reads the event position with `movsx` and shifts arithmetically (CARPET.EXE 0x59536/0x5953a `movsx esi, WORD PTR [edx+0x48]` ... `add 0x80` / `sar 8`), and the ring iterator `sub_114B0` sign-extends its template BYTES (EXE 0x29ccc/0x29cd8 `movsx ebx, BYTE PTR [edx]`). The port widened both as UNSIGNED. The tile INDEX is unaffected (same low byte either way), but `sub_40A10_40D50`'s origin latch compares the FULL i16 sum, so the unsigned reading hides the latch for every event sitting on the map wrap seam. WITNESS t=43542 slot 996 `(10,9)`: `x 317, y 65295` is centre (1, -1) signed and (1, 255) unsigned; with `+26 11->12` the radius is 2 and ring 2's `(-1, +1)` delta lands on (0, 0) -- retail latches, soft-freezes (`flags 0 -> 1024`) and spawns the `(10,18)` at slot 758, the port did neither.
